findings.evidence: `Mathlib/NumberTheory/ModularForms/Basic.lean:688` defines `ModularForm.translate` with the same slash function and bounded-at-cusps transport; line 705 defines `CuspForm.translate` with the same zero-at-cusps transport. Their `coe_translate` lemmas at lines 699 and 715 identify the result with `f ∣[k] g`.
findings.fix: Define their values using `ModularForm.translate f (mapGL ℝ g)` and `CuspForm.translate f (mapGL ℝ g)`, transporting the target subgroup via `Gamma1_map_conjAct_eq`; retain only the linearity packaging. This also eliminates the duplicated preservation scaffolding where no longer consumed.
findings.issue: `diamondOpAux` and the parallel `diamondOpCuspAux` at line 281 manually rebuild translated modular/cusp forms, duplicating Mathlib’s translation API and its cusp/invariance proofs.

summary: The auxiliary diamond operators reimplement Mathlib’s existing translation combinators instead of reusing them.
